## Overview

### Why

`POSTER_SIZES` claimed to make `next/image` pick a card poster no larger than the card. The docs site exports with `images: { unoptimized: true }`, so `next/image` renders each poster as a plain `<img>` with no `srcset` and drops `sizes`. The prop never changed which image file a visitor downloads.

### Behavior change

None. The homepage's HTML is the same as before.

### Checks

The pull request lists none. The homepage spec still checks that each favorite's poster loads with the right shape.

### Not covered

`DemoPoster.tsx` and `home-hero.tsx` keep `sizes="100vw"`, which does nothing either.

## Render the card poster without sizes

The card poster's `Image` drops `sizes`, and a comment says what to add if image optimization comes on. React Doctor's `nextjs-image-missing-sizes` rule reads the JSX but not `next.config.ts`, so the line carries an inline suppression.

[](apps/docs/src/components/favorites/favorites-list.tsx#L162-L167)

## Delete POSTER_SIZES

With no `sizes` prop left to feed, the constant goes.

[](apps/docs/src/components/favorites/favorites-list.tsx#L30-L31)
